articles.summary: CENTENNIAL, Colo., October 22, 2026 — Boom Supersonic today unveiled its first complete supersonic turbine core, unveiled a 2GW turbine superfactory, and announced it is developing the world’s most advanced all-digital foundry, capable of casting the world’s most advanced single crystal turbine blades and vanes. The Superfactory will create up to 500 high paying jobs. The Superfactory is operational now and already making turbine parts; first single crystal components are expected to ship in 2027.
articles.title: Boom Supersonic Completes First Turbine Core, Unveils 2GW Superpower Superfactory, Launches World’s Most Advanced Digital Foundry
